Container.Name: themerr
Container.Overview:
Themerr manages theme songs for Plex and Jellyfin using ThemerrDB. The web UI is available on port 9494. Port 9495 is used by the Jellyfin connector when the Themerr admin UI uses a self-signed certificate.
Before connecting a media server, create a persistent key file outside this container's /config directory. On Unraid, run:
mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/themerr && python3 -c 'import base64, os; print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(32)).decode())' > /mnt/user/appdata/themerr/themerr-tokens.key && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/themerr/themerr-tokens.key && chmod 600 /mnt/user/appdata/themerr/themerr-tokens.key.
Keep this file private and keep the same key when recreating the container. Losing the key requires signing in again.

Config.Name: Jellyfin connector port
Config.Description: Expose this port when Jellyfin must access the connector over HTTP because the Themerr admin UI uses a self-signed certificate. Configure Jellyfin with a host address reachable from Jellyfin; localhost inside another container refers to that container.

Config.Name: Token encryption key file
Config.Description: Create this file before starting the container. Keep it private and retain the same file across container recreations; losing it requires signing in again.

Config.Name: Token encryption key file path
Config.Description: Container path to the read-only token encryption key file.
